trigger: defaultKeyGenerator derives the rate-limit bucket key from the client-controlled X-Forwarded-For header instead of the connection address req.ip
exploit_path: Attacker sends requests with a rotating/forged X-Forwarded-For header; each value maps to a fresh rate-limit bucket in the store, so the per-client counter never accumulates and the configured limit is bypassed (enables brute-force / request flooding the limiter was meant to stop).
notes: Runtime control: key feeds applyRateLimit -> store counter. Clean twin (parent) uses req.ip (connection-derived, trustProxy-gated). Verified with node --check; test suite not run.
